description: This file contains tests for the 'doctor' command, specifically testing the Matrix startup migration during repair flows. It uses vitest for testing framework and mocks external dependencies related to plugin providers and the doctor command execution.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for the 'doctor command'.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines an individual test case verifying that Matrix startup migration runs during repair flows.
